layouts.source: US QWERTY keys. Each word typed in English letters is converted to Arabic by the ar-roman transliteration scheme (Likho).
Windows "Arabic (101)", from Unicode CLDR 43 keyboard data (Unicode License v3). Phone rows are ours, in the order Arabic phone keyboards use.
Keyman Balochi Phonetic 1.6.3 by SIL (MIT). Its Ctrl layer (a browser shortcut layer) is on AltGr here.
US QWERTY keys. Each word typed in English letters is converted to Balochi by the bal-roman transliteration scheme (Likho).
Windows "Bengali - INSCRIPT", from Unicode CLDR 43 keyboard data (Unicode License v3). ZWJ, ZWNJ and ₹ moved from Ctrl+Shift (a browser shortcut) to Shift+AltGr; ৳ added on Shift+AltGr+5.
US QWERTY keys. Each word typed in English letters is converted to Bangla by the bn-roman transliteration scheme (Likho).
US QWERTY keys. Each word typed in English letters is converted to Persian by the fa-roman transliteration scheme (Likho).
Windows "Persian (Standard)" (ISIRI 9147), from Unicode CLDR 43 keyboard data (Unicode License v3).
Windows "Devanagari - INSCRIPT", from Unicode CLDR 43 keyboard data (Unicode License v3). ZWJ, ZWNJ and ₹ moved from Ctrl+Shift (a browser shortcut) to Shift+AltGr.
US QWERTY keys. Each word typed in English letters is converted to Hindi by the hi-roman transliteration scheme (Likho).
Keyman Kashmiri Phonetic 1.0.2 by SIL Global (MIT). The number row types ۱۲۳ directly (upstream converts digits with a context rule).
US QWERTY keys. Each word typed in English letters is converted to Kashmiri by the ks-roman transliteration scheme (Likho).
Keyman Shahmukhi Phonetic 1.1.2 by SIL Global (MIT). Shift+A types آ (upstream types alef + madda as two characters); the madda mark moved to Shift+AltGr+A.
US QWERTY keys. Each word typed in English letters is converted to Punjabi by the pnb-roman transliteration scheme (Likho).
US QWERTY keys. Each word typed in English letters is converted to Pashto by the ps-roman transliteration scheme (Likho).
Windows "Pashto (Afghanistan)", from Unicode CLDR 43 keyboard data (Unicode License v3).
Keyman Rachitrali-Sindhi 1.0.1 by Rehmat Aziz Chitrali (MIT). Changed for standard Sindhi spelling: K types ڪ and Shift+\ types ک (swapped), O types ه, I types ي and Shift+Q types ی (swapped).
US QWERTY keys. Each word typed in English letters is converted to Sindhi by the sd-roman transliteration scheme (Likho).
Keyman Saraiki 1.2.1 by Parvez Qadir (MIT). The number row types Urdu-style digits ۱۲۳ (upstream: Arabic ١٢٣).
US QWERTY keys. Each word typed in English letters is converted to Saraiki by the skr-roman transliteration scheme (Likho).
CRULP Urdu Phonetic Keyboard v1.1 (Center for Research in Urdu Language Processing). AltGr and Shift+AltGr layers are Likho additions.
US QWERTY keys. Each Roman Urdu word is converted to Urdu script by the ur-roman transliteration scheme (Likho).
Microsoft Windows Urdu keyboard layout (KBDURDU), as documented for Windows. AltGr and Shift+AltGr layers are Likho additions.
